title: Orbix HandoffSpec
description: A task plan a frontier model hands to Orbix Core for free local execution. POST to http://127.0.0.1:51231/handoff with Authorization: Bearer <token>.

title.description: Names the run and any deliverable.

goal.description: One sentence of intent; injected as context into every prompt step.

deliverable.description: doc = branded .docx, panel = live panel in My UI, none (default).

kind.description: prompt = local model with prior outputs as context; action = shell command; tool = built-in Orbix tool.

instruction.description: prompt: the prompt text. action: the shell command. tool: a human label.

args.description: Tool arguments, e.g. {"url": "..."} for web_fetch or {"path": "..."} for file_read.

label.description: Optional short display label for the step.
